name: workflow-toolbox
description: Agents-only shim of the workflow-toolbox plugin, loaded by the observe server into delegated (server-launched) SDK sessions so workflow-toolbox:* agentTypes resolve there despite settingSources: []. Byte-identity-mirrored from plugin/agents/ (launch-agents-identity gate). It ships no context-injecting surfaces and ONE guard (the verifier-CLI guard, referenced via ../bin from the parent plugin, no bin/ dir of its own) wired on two matcher-narrowed events: PostToolUse/Bash records a flush-immune marker when a real external CLI invocation completes, and PreToolUse/StructuredOutput denies a self-answered verdict from the opencode/codex wrapper unless that marker (or the flushed transcript) proves the CLI ran — the fail-fast that STOPS the self-answer burn in these delegated (Path B) runs — the context it was measured in. EVERY OTHER agent (leaf/lean/etc.) runs effectively bare: the hook only spawns on a StructuredOutput or Bash call, instantly no-ops for any non-wrapper agent, and PostToolUse only ever writes a marker (never blocks). Not for interactive install — the full workflow-toolbox plugin already provides these agents + hooks.
